title: Rafael and the Vow
author: Sebastian Crane
blurb: Coral Lockridge, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
